label: Dense: about 1.0M tokens in the 0.10-0.20 band and 183k in 0.20-0.35, so it is on for most prose tokens at a low level. Its top end favours the token that completes a familiar multi-token name or fixed term: the last subword of a proper name (Eli|ade, Rh|ine, Tigr|is, Anj|ou, Ch|aim), regnal numerals (James I), author initials in citations, and set phrases (Internet of Things, Pap smear, amni|ocentesis). It also fires on letter and e-mail delimiters ('Regards,', 'From:').
